full_prompt_en: A square brightly colored fantasy portrait shows an anthropomorphic green frog from the chest up against a nearly flat hot-pink background. Its large head occupies the upper center, turned slightly toward the right. Bulging eyes sit high on the crown, each amber-orange iris half hooded by a dark eyelid, giving the frog a distant, deadpan expression. A broad orange mouth runs almost straight across the face, edged by multiple green and blue contour lines. Two small nostril marks punctuate the flatter middle of the muzzle. The skin is not a uniform green; dense, short, curving marks weave lime, emerald, turquoise, and dark teal around the cheeks and throat, turning the shape into a patterned volume. The frog wears a loose pale blue shirt with pink shadow lines and small buttons under a warm brown vest. The vest's seams, pocket, and rough textile planes are drawn with ochre and charcoal strokes. The crop cuts off the torso at the bottom and leaves generous unoccupied pink space on the right, so the head's wide profile reads clearly. The background has visible diagonal and circular brush marks, subtly shifting from coral pink at the top to a warmer orange glow at the lower right. Color is deliberately unnatural yet balanced: cool greens and blues in the subject oppose the saturated pink field, with orange mouth and vest bridging the two. Light is even and frontal, with almost no cast shadow; form comes from directional color strokes and contour layering. The whole image feels humorous, strange, and unexpectedly dignified, treating a simple improbable figure with the steady composition of a formal portrait.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形高彩奇想肖像呈现一只拟人绿蛙，从胸部以上置于近乎平涂的亮粉背景前。大头占据上方中央，略向右转。突起眼睛高高坐在头顶，每只琥珀橙色虹膜都被深眼皮盖住一半，使青蛙显出遥远而面无表情的神情。一张宽橙嘴几乎水平横过脸，边缘有多层绿蓝轮廓线。扁平吻部中央点着两个小鼻孔。皮肤并非均一绿色；密集短弯笔痕将青柠、翠绿、青绿和深蓝绿编织在脸颊、喉部，令形体成为有图案的体积。青蛙在暖棕马甲下穿宽松浅蓝衬衫，衣上有粉色阴影线和小纽扣。马甲的缝、口袋和粗纺织面由赭色与炭色笔触勾出。裁切从下方截断上身，右侧留下宽裕未占用的粉色空间，因此头的宽侧形清楚可读。背景有可见斜向和环形笔痕，从顶部珊瑚粉微妙转到右下更暖的橙亮。色彩故意不自然却平衡：主体冷绿蓝对抗饱和粉色底，橙嘴与马甲在两者间搭桥。光均匀而正面，几乎没有投影；体积来自定向色彩笔触和层叠轮廓。整幅画诙谐、奇异，又意外地庄重，用正式肖像的稳定构图对待一个简单而不可能的形体。
style_prompt_en: A vividly colored illustrative-painting treatment fills a square with a broad hot-pink field, then sets one large cool green-and-turquoise rounded mass slightly off center. Dense short curving strokes and layered blue-green contour bands shape the focal volume; a few warm orange horizontal marks cross it. The lower region adds looser pale blue and ochre-brown planes with sketchy seams and small dark details. The background is comparatively simple but not digitally flat: subtle diagonal and circular strokes create a coral-to-orange warmth near one lower corner. Cool and warm areas oppose one another directly, with the saturated pink occupying more negative space and the green mass carrying finer texture. Edges are confidently drawn but retain hand-worked irregularity. Lighting is broadly even, so form is conveyed chiefly through colored line direction, local value shifts, and overlapping planes rather than realistic cast shadow. The composition feels playful, oddly solemn, and very immediate, making a simple bold silhouette support an abundance of tactile color marks.
style_prompt_zh: 鲜明彩色的插画绘画处理以宽阔亮粉色域填满方形，再将一块大型冷绿青色圆浑体量稍偏中心地放入。密集短弯笔痕与层叠蓝绿轮廓带塑造焦点体积；少数暖橙水平记号横穿其上。下部加入更松散的浅蓝和赭棕色面，带草绘般接缝与小暗细节。背景相对简单，却非数字式平板：细微斜向与环形笔触在一个下角形成由珊瑚到橙色的暖意。冷暖区域直接对抗，饱和粉色占更多负空间，绿色体量则承载更细纹理。边缘自信地勾出，却保留手工处理的不规则。光广泛均匀，因此形体主要由彩线方向、局部明度变化与平面叠压传达，而非真实投影。构图俏皮、奇异地庄重且十分直接，让简单大胆剪影承载丰盛有触感的彩色笔痕。
theme_en: A wide-eyed green frog in a blue shirt and brown vest against a vivid pink field
theme_zh: 亮粉色背景前，穿蓝衬衫和棕马甲的绿蛙肖像
name: Matt Furie
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
